Group rides in Vermont

3 recurring group rides around Vermont: 1 social, 1 road, 1 mountain bike. 1 roll on weeknights, 0 on weekends. New to group rides? Start with Vermont Bicycle Shop Pizza Ride in Barre — it's no-drop, nobody gets left. Want to go fast? GMBC Wednesday Evening Training Ride runs groups by average speed, 15 mph minimum.
